corridor: Cinematic film still. An empty, sterile white test-chamber corridor inside an underground research facility: walls of square matte white panels with thin dark seams, dark grey brushed-metal floor panels, cold fluorescent ceiling strips flickering on one by one, faint dust in the air, symmetrical one-point perspective. Photoreal, anamorphic 35mm, no text, no logos.
ai_wake: Cinematic film still. A colossal mechanical construct hangs from the ceiling of a vast dark industrial chamber: a slender, elegant white robotic body suspended upside down from a tangle of black cables and hydraulic arms, ringed by white curved disc plates, with a single round optic eye glowing warm yellow. Volumetric light beams, haze, menacing and graceful. Photoreal, anamorphic, no text, no logos.
ai_red: Cinematic film still. A colossal white robotic body hanging upside down from a ceiling of black cables in a dark industrial chamber, lunging forward, its single round optic eye glowing angry red, red light flooding the haze, sparks. Photoreal, dramatic, anamorphic, no text, no logos.
ai_eye: Extreme close-up cinematic macro shot of a single round mechanical camera eye set in glossy white robotic plating, the iris lens glowing warm yellow, concentric aperture rings, reflections, dark background. Photoreal, no text, no logos.
glassbox: Cinematic film still. A young woman in her twenties with dark brown hair pulled back in a ponytail, wearing an orange jumpsuit with its top half tied around her waist by the sleeves and a white tank top, sitting up on a bed inside a small sterile glass-walled cell, just waking, groggy, cold white light, a muted painting on the wall. Photoreal, 35mm, shallow depth of field, no text, no logos.
watched: Cinematic film still, low angle wide shot. A small lone young woman with a dark ponytail and an orange jumpsuit tied at the waist stands in a huge white test chamber of square white panels, looking up at a dark observation window high on the wall, where a faint yellow light glows behind the glass. Cold, clinical, dusty. Photoreal, anamorphic, no text, no logos.
device: Cinematic close-up. A young woman's hands holding a sleek handheld device made of white plastic with black accents and three prongs around a glowing blue crystal tip, in a sterile white chamber. Orange jumpsuit sleeves tied at her waist visible below. Photoreal, shallow depth of field, no text, no logos.
boots: Cinematic close-up of a young woman's lower legs landing on a dark grey metal floor: she wears long-fall boots with white curved spring blades running from the back of the calf down to the heel, orange jumpsuit legs, a small burst of dust on impact. Photoreal, low angle, shallow depth of field, no text, no logos.
face: Cinematic close-up portrait of a young woman in her twenties with dark brown hair pulled back in a ponytail and blue eyes, deadpan unimpressed expression, completely silent, white tank top, cold clinical overhead light, slight sweat and dust on her skin, white panel wall blurred behind. Photoreal, 85mm, shallow depth of field, no text.
cake: Cinematic film still. At the far end of a long, dark, rusted industrial maintenance corridor, a single chocolate cake with one lit candle sits on a small pedestal under a lone spotlight. Eerie, tempting, haze. Photoreal, anamorphic, no text, no logos.
running: Cinematic film still, motion blur. A young woman with a dark ponytail, white tank top and orange jumpsuit tied at her waist, sprinting through a bright white test chamber, holding a white handheld device with a glowing tip, white spring-blade boots. Dynamic tracking shot. Photoreal, anamorphic, no text, no logos.
portals: Cinematic film still. A white sterile test chamber of square panels; on the far wall a glowing vivid blue oval portal ring, and on the grey floor a glowing vivid orange oval portal ring, each showing a view of another room through it, light spilling from their rims onto the panels. Photoreal, anamorphic, no text, no logos.
doors: Cinematic film still. An endless succession of identical round white sliding doors opening one after another down a long white corridor, receding into infinity, cold light, uncanny symmetry. Photoreal, no text, no logos.
fall: Cinematic film still, top-down view. A young woman in an orange jumpsuit and white tank top falling feet-first down a tall vertical shaft lined with white panels, arms out, hair whipping, a glowing orange oval far below. Vertigo, motion blur. Photoreal, no text, no logos.
landing: Cinematic film still. A young woman with a dark ponytail, orange jumpsuit tied at the waist and white spring-blade boots, crouched on one knee just after landing from a great height on a grey metal floor, a ring of dust around her, looking up calmly. Photoreal, low angle, anamorphic, no text, no logos.
breakout: Cinematic film still. A young woman with a dark ponytail and orange jumpsuit tied at the waist squeezing through a gap between broken white wall panels into the dark rusty maintenance space behind the test chamber, pipes, catwalks, shafts of light, dust. Photoreal, anamorphic, no text, no logos.
incinerator: Cinematic film still. A grey metal companion cube with soft pink heart emblems on each face sinking into a square pit glowing with orange incinerator fire, in a dim white chamber, embers rising. Melancholy. Photoreal, no text, no logos.
panels: Cinematic film still, looking straight up. The ceiling of a white test chamber made of square white panels mounted on black robotic arms, rearranging and folding overhead in a mechanical ballet, cold light leaking between them. Photoreal, no text, no logos.
sentries: Cinematic film still. A row of small white egg-shaped sentry robots on thin tripod legs standing in a dark room, each with a single glowing red eye projecting a thin red laser beam through the haze. Ominous yet cute. Photoreal, anamorphic, no text, no logos.
file: Cinematic film still. A young woman with a dark ponytail and white tank top reading a worn paper file folder by the light of a flickering lamp in a dark maintenance room, unimpressed expression. Photoreal, shallow depth of field, no text visible, no logos.
camera: Cinematic film still. A small white security camera with a single glowing lens mounted on a white panel wall, turning to watch; in the foreground, out of focus, the back of a young woman's head with a dark ponytail looking up at it. Photoreal, no text, no logos.
poison: Cinematic film still. A vast dark industrial chamber filling with thick glowing green toxic fog, a colossal white robotic body hanging upside down from the ceiling above it, its single eye glowing yellow through the fog. Photoreal, volumetric, no text, no logos.
decay: Cinematic film still. A ruined abandoned white test chamber overgrown with vines, grass and leaves, broken square panels hanging loose showing rusted metal frames, shafts of daylight through holes in the ceiling, dust. Photoreal, anamorphic, no text, no logos.
moon: Cinematic film still. The full moon in a black starry sky, highly detailed grey cratered surface, with a small glowing orange oval portal ring on its surface. Photoreal astrophotography, no text, no logos.
dawn_run: Cinematic film still. Hopeful, wide shot. Photoreal, anamorphic, no text, no logos.
walkaway: Cinematic film still, extreme wide shot at dawn. A tiny lone figure walking away across an endless golden wheat field toward the rising sun, long shadow, soft mist, a small dark shed far behind her. Peaceful, hopeful. Photoreal, anamorphic, no text, no logos.
